lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits. A distinct vertical column of four spots is present immediately posterior to the pectoral fin base, followed by a more irregular triangular distribution of local maxima towards the posterior mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-to-dark transitions from the dorsal to ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs distributed across the lateral surface, with a higher concentration along the anterior leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density clustering of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more uniform blobs on the primary lateral flank.
